# Madagascar

The wealth gradients this library holds for Madagascar: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −1.07 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2021 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **−0.38** | DHS 2021 |
| `mort_gradient` | 1.29 − 0.244 × ln(GNI per person); e.g. −0.40 at $1,000, −0.79 at $5,000 | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) (no census measurement) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.85 | −1.17 | −0.86 | −0.74 | −0.98 | −1.46 | −2.05 |
